value.rationale: The balanced 2d/2d allocation is a natural low-redundancy competitor to published 2d+1/2d−1 concentric designs, and its universal injectivity has a sharp geometric obstruction rather than generic-position hypotheses. Recovering both complete circle intensities from precisely 4d samples and determining the uniquely optimally staggered Nyquist geometry provides constructive design and a full exact classification, not a routine scalar example. Full nonlinear noise stability is explicitly outside the claim.
